changeSet.author: ALadchenko
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AssetType]( [ID] int identity(1,1) NOT NULL, [Name] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, [Description] nvarchar(max) NULL, [Class] int constraint [DF_AssetType_Class] default(1) NOT NULL, [DisplayFormat] nvarchar(250) constraint [DF_AssetType_DisplayFormat] default('{ID}') NOT NULL, [State] int constraint [DF_AssetType_State] default(1) NOT NULL, [Hierarchical] bit constraint [DF_AssetType_Hierarchical] default(0) NOT NULL, [HierarchyPredicateID] int NULL, [HierarchyIntersectTypeID] int NULL, [HierarchyMaximumDepth] int constraint [DF_AssetType_HierarchyMaximumDepth] default(0) NOT NULL, [Object] varchar(50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] int constraint [DF_AssetType_ObjectId] default(NEXT VALUE FOR [dbo].[AssetType_ObjectID_Seq]) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] datetime NULL, [CreatedBy] int NULL, [UpdatedOn] datetime NULL, [UpdatedBy] int NULL, [Notes] nvarchar(max) NULL, [uid] uniqueidentifier constraint [DF_AssetType_uid] default(newid()) NOT NULL, [UseAsTransformation] [bit] constraint [DF_AssetType_UseAsTransformation] default(0) NOT NULL, [HashValue] [binary](20) NULL, [AutoDisplayParent] [bit] constraint DF_AssetType_AutoDisplayParent default(0) NOT NULL, [FlowObjectType] int null, CanEditParent bit constraint DF_AssetType_CanEditParent default(1) not null, CONSTRAINT [PK_AssetType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [AssetType_Object_ObjectId] UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_AssetType_Object_ObjectID_Include') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_AssetType_Object_ObjectID_Include] ON [dbo].[AssetType] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) INCLUDE([ID]) END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [dbo].[AssetType] WHERE Name = 'MetricAllocation' AND Class = 16) BEGIN insert into AssetType ( Name, Description, [Class], DisplayFormat, [State] , [Hierarchical], [HierarchyPredicateID], [HierarchyIntersectTypeID], [HierarchyMaximumDepth] , [Object], [ObjectID] , [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [UpdatedOn], [UpdatedBy] , [Notes], [uid]) values ( 'MetricAllocation','A Metric Allocation',16, '{Name}', 1 , 0, NULL, NULL, 0 , 'MetricAllocation', 1 , GETDATE(), 0, GETDATE(), 0 , NULL, '00000001-0000-0000-0000-B00000000013') END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [dbo].[AssetType] WHERE Name = 'Predicate' AND Class = 17) BEGIN insert into AssetType ( Name, Description, [Class], DisplayFormat, [State] , [Hierarchical], [HierarchyPredicateID], [HierarchyIntersectTypeID], [HierarchyMaximumDepth] , [Object], [ObjectID] , [CreatedOn], [CreatedBy], [UpdatedOn], [UpdatedBy] , [Notes], [uid]) values ( 'Predicate','A Predicate',17,'{Name}',1 , 0, NULL, NULL, 0 , 'Predicate', 1 , GETDATE(), 0, GETDATE(), 0 , NULL, '00000001-0000-0000-0000-B00000000014') END
IF COL_LENGTH('dbo.AssetType', 'IsDescriptionEnabled') IS NULL BEGIN alter table dbo.AssetType add IsDescriptionEnabled bit constraint [DF_AssetType_IsDescriptionEnabled] default(1) not null, IsDescriptionVisibleByDefault bit constraint [DF_AssetType_IsDescriptionVisibleByDefault] default(0) not null, DescriptionButtonName varchar(50) null END

changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[AssetType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[AssetType] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', [Object], ObjectID, coalesce(CreatedBy, 0)), [Object], ObjectID from inserted;

INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Update', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', [Object], ObjectID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), [Object], ObjectID from inserted;
